title: 大壩施工導流
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction
summary: 本課以大壩施工導流為入口，深入施工導流的洪水暴露、過流能力與階段轉換。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using River diversion during dam construction as its entry point, this course examines diversion flood exposure, hydraulic capacity and construction transitions. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工期洪水暴露」與「明渠導流的過水能力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Construction-period flood exposure" and "Open-channel diversion capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工期洪水暴露：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction-period flood exposure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工期洪水暴露」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction-period flood exposure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 施工導流的風險與暴露時間及洪水季節分布有關，重現期不是保證多久才發生一次。短期工程仍可能遇到大洪水，且後果隨開挖、圍堰和永久壩體所處階段改變。 假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。 把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。即使超越機率相同，不同階段的損失與恢復時間仍可能完全不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工期洪水暴露」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diversion risk depends on exposure duration and seasonal flood distribution. Return period is not a guaranteed waiting time, and consequences change as excavation, cofferdams and permanent works pass through different construction stages. Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. At least one exceedance in three years has probability 0.142625, or 14.2625 percent, not a seasonal-window probability. Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. Equal exceedance probabilities can also correspond to very different losses and recovery times at different stages of construction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Construction-period flood exposure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工期洪水暴露」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Construction-period flood exposure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工期洪水暴露
knowledge.text: 施工導流的風險與暴露時間及洪水季節分布有關，重現期不是保證多久才發生一次。短期工程仍可能遇到大洪水，且後果隨開挖、圍堰和永久壩體所處階段改變。
knowledge.textEn: Diversion risk depends on exposure duration and seasonal flood distribution. Return period is not a guaranteed waiting time, and consequences change as excavation, cofferdams and permanent works pass through different construction stages.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「大壩施工導流」的「施工期洪水暴露：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「水庫數據調度桌」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Construction-period flood exposure: mechanism and system paths” in “River diversion during dam construction”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Reservoir data planning desk” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「施工期洪水暴露」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction-period flood exposure" is correct?
options: 二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。
施工導流的風險與暴露時間及洪水季節分布有關，重現期不是保證多久才發生一次。
導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。
optionsEn: A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years.
Diversion risk depends on exposure duration and seasonal flood distribution.
Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity.
quiz.explanation: 施工導流的風險與暴露時間及洪水季節分布有關，重現期不是保證多久才發生一次。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Diversion risk depends on exposure duration and seasonal flood distribution. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工期洪水暴露：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction-period flood exposure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工期洪水暴露」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction-period flood exposure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. At least one exceedance in three years has probability 0.142625, or 14.2625 percent, not a seasonal-window probability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. At least one exceedance in three years has probability 0.142625, or 14.2625 percent, not a seasonal-window probability.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工期洪水暴露」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction-period flood exposure", which statement holds?
options: 入口有效面積減少百分之二十，水頭損失也一定只增加百分之二十。
兩個河道的弗勞德數相同，就能保證最終沖刷深度完全相同。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%。
optionsEn: Reducing entrance area by twenty percent always raises head loss by only twenty percent.
Equal Froude numbers in two channels guarantee identical final scour depth.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工期洪水暴露：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction-period flood exposure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工期洪水暴露」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction-period flood exposure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。另列洪水樣本的季節涵蓋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Check long-term trends and upstream regulation changes, recording stage exposure, peak uncertainty and inundation consequences in a traceable risk assessment. Document seasonal coverage of the flood sample separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以施工期洪水暴露編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。另列洪水樣本的季節涵蓋。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for construction-period flood exposure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Check long-term trends and upstream regulation changes, recording stage exposure, peak uncertainty and inundation consequences in a traceable risk assessment. Document seasonal coverage of the flood sample separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。另列洪水樣本的季節涵蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Check long-term trends and upstream regulation changes, recording stage exposure, peak uncertainty and inundation consequences in a traceable risk assessment. Document seasonal coverage of the flood sample separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以施工期洪水暴露編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。另列洪水樣本的季節涵蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for construction-period flood exposure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Check long-term trends and upstream regulation changes, recording stage exposure, peak uncertainty and inundation consequences in a traceable risk assessment. Document seasonal coverage of the flood sample separately.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工期洪水暴露」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Construction-period flood exposure"?
options: 以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
洪峰流量減去導流能力的差值，就是洪水所需的暫存體積。
optionsEn: Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Peak inflow minus diversion capacity directly equals the required flood-storage volume.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工期洪水暴露：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction-period flood exposure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工期洪水暴露」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction-period flood exposure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。即使超越機率相同，不同階段的損失與恢復時間仍可能完全不同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. Equal exceedance probabilities can also correspond to very different losses and recovery times at different stages of construction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：即使超越機率相同，不同階段的損失與恢復時間仍可能完全不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equal exceedance probabilities can also correspond to very different losses and recovery times at different stages of construction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。即使超越機率相同，不同階段的損失與恢復時間仍可能完全不同。
knowledge.textEn: Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. Equal exceedance probabilities can also correspond to very different losses and recovery times at different stages of construction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工期洪水暴露」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction-period flood exposure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。
導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence.
Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity.
quiz.explanation: 把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 明渠導流的過水能力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Open-channel diversion capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「明渠導流的過水能力」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Open-channel diversion capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 明渠能力取決於斷面、水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度，不能只看開挖面積。均勻流公式可初估穩定長渠，但入口、彎道和下游回水需要另行評估。 SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。假設矩形渠寬10 m、水深3 m、曼寧n=0.025、坡度0.001，A=30 m²、R=30/16=1.875 m，Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n=57.701 m³/s；均勻流。 局部收縮或彎道可能先控制水位，堆料和漂流物又會降低有效斷面。若只增加平均水深來滿足公式流量，可能漏掉局部溢頂或岸坡沖蝕問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「明渠導流的過水能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Open-channel capacity depends on section, hydraulic radius, slope and roughness, not excavated area alone. Uniform-flow relations estimate a long stable reach, while entrance effects, bends and downstream backwater require separate analysis. The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3). Assume rectangular width 10 m, depth 3 m, Manning n=0.025 and slope 0.001. Area is 30 m² and radius 1.875 m, giving uniform-flow capacity approximately 57.701 m³/s. A contraction or bend can control stage before the uniform reach does, while stored material and debris reduce effective area. Increasing assumed average depth to meet discharge can overlook local overtopping or bank erosion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Open-channel diversion capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「明渠導流的過水能力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Open-channel diversion capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 明渠導流的過水能力
knowledge.text: 明渠能力取決於斷面、水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度，不能只看開挖面積。均勻流公式可初估穩定長渠，但入口、彎道和下游回水需要另行評估。
knowledge.textEn: Open-channel capacity depends on section, hydraulic radius, slope and roughness, not excavated area alone. Uniform-flow relations estimate a long stable reach, while entrance effects, bends and downstream backwater require separate analysis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「明渠導流的過水能力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Open-channel diversion capacity" is correct?
options: 導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。
導流隧洞的摩阻係數不分Darcy或Fanning定義都能直接代入同一公式。
明渠能力取決於斷面、水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度，不能只看開挖面積。
optionsEn: Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity.
Darcy and Fanning friction factors can be used interchangeably in the same tunnel formula.
Open-channel capacity depends on section, hydraulic radius, slope and roughness, not excavated area alone.
quiz.explanation: 明渠能力取決於斷面、水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度，不能只看開挖面積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Open-channel capacity depends on section, hydraulic radius, slope and roughness, not excavated area alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 明渠導流的過水能力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Open-channel diversion capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「明渠導流的過水能力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Open-channel diversion capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。假設矩形渠寬10 m、水深3 m、曼寧n=0.025、坡度0.001，A=30 m²、R=30/16=1.875 m，Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n=57.701 m³/s；均勻流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3). Assume rectangular width 10 m, depth 3 m, Manning n=0.025 and slope 0.001. Area is 30 m² and radius 1.875 m, giving uniform-flow capacity approximately 57.701 m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用實測縱斷面和水面線確認是否接近均勻流，分段記錄粗糙度與阻水物；以不同尾水條件重算回水，並用流速量測核對斷面流量，不能將渠底坡直接當所有情境的能量坡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check measured bed and water-surface profiles for near-uniform flow, recording roughness and obstructions by reach.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。假設矩形渠寬10 m、水深3 m、曼寧n=0.025、坡度0.001，A=30 m²、R=30/16=1.875 m，Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n=57.701 m³/s；均勻流。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3). Assume rectangular width 10 m, depth 3 m, Manning n=0.025 and slope 0.001. Area is 30 m² and radius 1.875 m, giving uniform-flow capacity approximately 57.701 m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「明渠導流的過水能力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Open-channel diversion capacity", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。
圍堰只是臨時構造，所以抗滑計算可以不扣除基底揚壓。
截流缺口縮小時，河道流量分配和水深必定保持原值不變。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3).
Because a cofferdam is temporary, uplift can be omitted from its sliding calculation.
During gap closure, discharge partition and water depth necessarily remain unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 明渠導流的過水能力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Open-channel diversion capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「明渠導流的過水能力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Open-channel diversion capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用實測縱斷面和水面線確認是否接近均勻流，分段記錄粗糙度與阻水物；以不同尾水條件重算回水，並用流速量測核對斷面流量，不能將渠底坡直接當所有情境的能量坡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check measured bed and water-surface profiles for near-uniform flow, recording roughness and obstructions by reach. Recalculate backwater for different tailwaters and verify section discharge with velocities rather than assuming bed slope always equals energy slope. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以明渠導流的過水能力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用實測縱斷面和水面線確認是否接近均勻流，分段記錄粗糙度與阻水物；以不同尾水條件重算回水，並用流速量測核對斷面流量，不能將渠底坡直接當所有情境的能量坡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for open-channel diversion capacity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check measured bed and water-surface profiles for near-uniform flow, recording roughness and obstructions by reach. Recalculate backwater for different tailwaters and verify section discharge with velocities rather than assuming bed slope always equals energy slope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部收縮或彎道可能先控制水位，堆料和漂流物又會降低有效斷面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A contraction or bend can control stage before the uniform reach does, while stored material and debris reduce effective area. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用實測縱斷面和水面線確認是否接近均勻流，分段記錄粗糙度與阻水物；以不同尾水條件重算回水，並用流速量測核對斷面流量，不能將渠底坡直接當所有情境的能量坡。
knowledge.textEn: Check measured bed and water-surface profiles for near-uniform flow, recording roughness and obstructions by reach. Recalculate backwater for different tailwaters and verify section discharge with velocities rather than assuming bed slope always equals energy slope.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以明渠導流的過水能力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用實測縱斷面和水面線確認是否接近均勻流，分段記錄粗糙度與阻水物；以不同尾水條件重算回水，並用流速量測核對斷面流量，不能將渠底坡直接當所有情境的能量坡。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for open-channel diversion capacity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check measured bed and water-surface profiles for near-uniform flow, recording roughness and obstructions by reach. Recalculate backwater for different tailwaters and verify section discharge with velocities rather than assuming bed slope always equals energy slope.

quiz.question: 要驗證「明渠導流的過水能力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Open-channel diversion capacity"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用實測縱斷面和水面線確認是否接近均勻流，分段記錄粗糙度與阻水物；以不同尾水條件重算回水，並用流速量測核對斷面流量，不能將渠底坡直接當所有情境的能量坡。
基坑抽水量增加必定代表整片地基的透水係數同步增加。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check measured bed and water-surface profiles for near-uniform flow, recording roughness and obstructions by reach.
Increasing excavation pumping always means permeability increased uniformly throughout the foundation.
quiz.explanation: 用實測縱斷面和水面線確認是否接近均勻流，分段記錄粗糙度與阻水物；以不同尾水條件重算回水，並用流速量測核對斷面流量，不能將渠底坡直接當所有情境的能量坡。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check measured bed and water-surface profiles for near-uniform flow, recording roughness and obstructions by reach. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: Open-channel diversion capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「明渠導流的過水能力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 局部收縮或彎道可能先控制水位，堆料和漂流物又會降低有效斷面。若只增加平均水深來滿足公式流量，可能漏掉局部溢頂或岸坡沖蝕問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A contraction or bend can control stage before the uniform reach does, while stored material and debris reduce effective area. Increasing assumed average depth to meet discharge can overlook local overtopping or bank erosion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只增加平均水深來滿足公式流量，可能漏掉局部溢頂或岸坡沖蝕問題。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
